bullets: Lions DT Skyler Gill-Howard Out For Season With Knee Injury ([NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/lions-dt-skyler-gill-howard-out-for-season-with-knee-injury/))

Lions DT Skyler Gill-Howard is out for the season after suffering a knee injury on a goal line offensive rep last week vs the Bucs ([Dave Birkett](https://bsky.app/profile/davebirkett.bsky.social/post/3n33et46nq222))

Skyler Gill-Howard, Detroit's impressive and versatile rookie, suffered a season-ending injury when he was blocking on a goal line snap and the running back was tackled into the back of his left leg. ([Justin Rogers](https://bsky.app/profile/detroitfootball.net/post/3n33g5eh6np2x))
Skyler Gill-Howard is done for the season. ([Justin Rogers](https://bsky.app/profile/detroitfootball.net/post/3n33ehilvyj2z))
